purpose: Body-free qualification of the exact multi-site SeagrassNet download response before biological data access.
candidate_universe: exact USA+Canada site UUID universe reproduced by the v1 preflight fingerprint; no outcome-based site selection

request.query_value: comma-joined candidate site UUID ids in deterministic code/UUID order

pass_rule: HTTP 2xx with a declared Content-Type or Content-Disposition sufficient to freeze the return container/parser class.
stop_rule: Any transport failure, authentication requirement, non-2xx status, or absence of both content type and disposition stops v2 before biological response access.
